mechanism: Both drugs can cause photosensitivity and gastrointestinal upset; primaquine may increase hemolytic risk in G6PD-deficient patients while minocycline can exacerbate this through oxidative stress.
action: Monitor for photosensitivity reactions and GI symptoms; ensure G6PD status is known before primaquine use; counsel on sun protection and take minocycline with adequate water to prevent esophageal irritation.
